name: confirm-button
title: Confirm Button
description: A hold-to-confirm button with a directional color fill and configurable hold duration.

useCases: Deliberate confirmation actions that require an uninterrupted pointer or keyboard hold.
limitations: onConfirm fires once per completed hold. The caller handles asynchronous work and errors. Confirmation stays visible for two seconds after release before resetting. Click-only activation does not confirm.
requirements: React 19.2 or later, Tailwind CSS 4, and the shared UI Button. Supply onConfirm in a client component. duration is in seconds; direction is right, left, up, or down.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/confirm-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
